data.narrative:
Simbe Robotics is a Series C-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $100M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable in the robotics sector, including companies such as Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Hadrian across Series B and Series D stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $100M total raised proxy and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $170M. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. The peer set includes Exotec and Hadrian at $2.0B and $1.6B respectively at Series D, alongside Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Generalist AI at $1.8B, $1.6B, and $2.0B at Series B.

Triangulation across both methods produces a valuation range of $144M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $910M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-adjusted multiples for frontier robotics assets and the heterogeneity of peer capital structures and revenue profiles. Key downside risks include stage discount relative to later-stage peers; upside hinges on revenue traction and capital efficiency relative to the peer cohort.
